description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance metric "CoLeG-E (%)" across three different model scales evaluated under four distinct training conditions. The horizontal axis displays the categorical models, arranged from left to right as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The vertical value axis is labeled "CoLeG-E (%)" and employs a linear scale that ranges from 0 to slightly above 50, with numeric tick labels appearing at regular intervals of 10 units. Within each model category, the data is visually arranged into a group of four side-by-side bars, whose corresponding conditions are mapped in a top-left legend. The leftmost bar in each group represents "no SFT" and is colored light blue with top-left to bottom-right diagonal white stripes; the second bar represents "+ SFT on $D_0$" in light orange with horizontal white stripes; the third bar represents "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" in light purple with bottom-left to top-right diagonal white stripes; and the rightmost bar represents "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" in solid light pink. The shortest bar in the chart corresponds to the "no SFT" condition for LLaMA-2-7B at an approximate value of 4%, whereas the tallest bar represents the "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" condition for LLaMA-2-70B at roughly 51%. Across all three categorical groups, the bars consistently ascend in height from left to right. The "no SFT" values measure approximately 4%, 8.5%, and 26.5% across the three progressively larger models, while the solid pink "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" bars reach approximate values of 30.5%, 39%, and 51%, respectively. Visual emphasis is provided by the distinct white striped patterns and contrasting pastel colors that differentiate the four data series within the sequentially ordered model groups.
